name: Praxis Packaging

Since 1989, Praxis has offered comprehensive contract packaging solutions designed to help organizations scale, streamline, enhance performance, and accelerate speed to market.
about:
Praxis Packaging was founded in 1989 in Grand Rapids, Michigan, as a contract packaging provider for the life sciences and consumer health sectors. The company operates cGMP-compliant, DEA-registered (Schedules III-V) facilities offering primary solid dose packaging — bottling and blistering — along with liquid filling for creams, pastes, lotions, and oils. Secondary packaging services include labeling, cartoning, bundling, kitting, clamshell blistering, and stretch carding. Praxis also provides DSCSA serialization with aggregation and EPCIS integration, rework and inspection, and cGMP cold chain storage, with 24/7 operations available for time-sensitive projects.

The company serves pharmaceutical, biotech, animal health, medical device, nutritional, and personal care markets. Customers include Rx and OTC pharmaceutical manufacturers, biotech firms requiring vial labeling and complex kitting, medical device companies needing precision kitting and domestic production of NIOSH-approved surgical N95 respirators, animal health brands, nutritional supplement companies, and personal care brands for cosmetics, skin care, and oral hygiene products.

Praxis emphasizes quality, innovation, and customer success as differentiators, positioning itself as a strategic partner for speed to market through flexibility, responsiveness, and agility. Its 35-plus years of experience, comprehensive quality systems, and domestic manufacturing capabilities for NIOSH-approved respirators are cited as foundations for reliability.
